query: Construct the truth table for P AND Q.
reasoning:
1. Recall the value of (P AND Q) when P=true and Q=true: true.
2. Recall the value of (P AND Q) when P=true and Q=false: false.
3. Recall the value of (P AND Q) when P=false and Q=true: false.
4. Recall the value of (P AND Q) when P=false and Q=false: false.
5. Assemble the four results (true, false, false, false from steps 1-4) into a table with columns P, Q, P AND Q.
answer:
| P | Q | P AND Q |
|-------|-------|---------|
| true  | true  | true    |
| true  | false | false   |
| false | true  | false   |
| false | false | false   |
